rows.note: Use this for the sweet liquid produced by flowers; it is the all-purpose rendering for the biological sense.

example.english: The bees are attracted by nectar.
example.traditional: 啲蜜蜂靠花蜜吸引過嚟。
example.jyutping: di1 mat6 fung1 kaau3 faa1 mat6 kap1 jan5 gwo3 lai4

rows.note: Use this when the nectar is a sweetened fruit juice, rather than for nectar as a general poetic description of any drink.

example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 jam2 gwo2 zap1
